frequency_question: How often do announced major bilateral trade tariffs on key partners actually take effect on schedule rather than being rescinded or replaced by a deal?
membership_rule: Includes: formal executive announcements of steep sector-specific tariffs with a defined future implementation date against major allies (Canada, Mexico, EU, Japan, China). Excludes routine anti-dumping duties or minor administrative trade enforcement actions.
